one_sentence_story: Katherine Scangos, Edward Chang, Andrew Krystal, and colleagues (Nature Medicine, Oct 2021) mapped a 36-year-old woman ('Sarah') with severe treatment-resistant depression using 10 days of multi-site intracranial stereo-EEG, discovering a right-amygdala gamma biomarker that predicted symptom spikes with 87% accuracy and triggered a closed-loop ventral striatum pacemaker (~300 six-second pulses/day) that dropped her MADRS depression score from 36 to 10!
so_what_for_you: Understanding how your amygdala and ventral striatum interact lets you work with your brain's hardware instead of fighting it.
